weather_code_definitions.3: Light snow or light rain with scattered clouds

source_variables.instant: Source row identifier; not a demand predictor.
source_variables.dteday: Calendar date associated with the hourly or daily record.
source_variables.season: UCI season category code: 1 spring, 2 summer, 3 fall, 4 winter.
source_variables.hr: Hour of day, 0 through 23; hourly table only.
source_variables.holiday: Whether the date is a source-calendar holiday.
source_variables.workingday: Whether the source marks the date as a working day.
source_variables.weathersit: UCI weather category code; see weather_code_definitions.
source_variables.temp: Normalized air temperature; approximately Celsius = temp × 41.
source_variables.atemp: Normalized feels-like temperature; approximately Celsius = atemp × 50.
source_variables.hum: Normalized relative humidity; approximately percent = hum × 100.
source_variables.windspeed: Normalized wind speed; approximately km/h = windspeed × 67.
source_variables.casual: Observed completed rentals by casual users.
source_variables.registered: Observed completed rentals by registered users.
source_variables.cnt: Observed total completed rentals; equals casual + registered in source data.

engineered_variables.was_missing: 1 when the hourly timestamp is absent from the source; demand remains unknown.
engineered_variables.is_observed: 1 only for source-observed hourly rows; used to exclude unknown targets.
engineered_variables.outage_day: Configured October 29–30, 2012 event-date flag; not a measured outage label.
engineered_variables.potential_outage: Missing-hour candidate flag from event dates or a >=6-hour gap; unconfirmed.
engineered_variables.context_imputed: Marks calendar/weather context filled only to render the complete grid.
engineered_variables.temp_c: Approximate Celsius temperature for interpretable relationships and OPS modeling.
engineered_variables.wind_reported_zero: Source windspeed equals zero; quality flag retained for review.
engineered_variables.hr_sin: Sine cyclic encoding of hour so adjacent clock hours remain close in feature space.
engineered_variables.hr_cos: Cosine cyclic encoding of hour so adjacent clock hours remain close in feature space.
engineered_variables.rain_or_snow: Indicator for source weather codes 3 or 4.
engineered_variables.commute_peak: Working-day indicator for the configured 07–09 and 16–19 hours.
engineered_variables.mnth_sin: Sine cyclic encoding of month to represent year-boundary continuity.
engineered_variables.mnth_cos: Cosine cyclic encoding of month to represent year-boundary continuity.
engineered_variables.hr_month_sin_sin: Interaction between hourly sine and monthly sine.
engineered_variables.hr_month_sin_cos: Interaction between hourly sine and monthly cosine.
engineered_variables.hr_month_cos_sin: Interaction between hourly cosine and monthly sine.
engineered_variables.hr_month_cos_cos: Interaction between hourly cosine and monthly cosine.
engineered_variables.casual_share: Descriptive target-derived rider mix; not included in PLAN or OPS predictor lists.
engineered_variables.bikes_in_use: Little's Law estimate from completed rentals and assumed 12/30-minute trip durations; not observed inventory.
engineered_variables.lag_24: Estimated use at t−24h; latest historical target available to day-ahead OPS.
engineered_variables.lag_168: Estimated use at the same hour one week earlier (t−168h).
engineered_variables.lag_336: Estimated use at the same hour two weeks earlier (t−336h).
engineered_variables.roll24: Mean target estimate over t−47h through t−24h (at least 18 observed values).
engineered_variables.roll168: Mean target estimate over t−191h through t−24h (at least 120 observed values).
engineered_variables.demand_trend_7d: Difference between recent and preceding seven-day means, both ending before target time.

OPS.purpose: Rolling day-ahead use estimates with history cut off at t−24h; all rolling windows use earlier observed targets only.

target_and_assumptions.observed_demand: cnt, casual, and registered are completed rentals observed by the source.
target_and_assumptions.estimated_use: bikes_in_use is derived with Little's Law and assumed rider-specific trip durations.

leakage_controls: casual_share and bikes_in_use are target-derived and are not predictor features.
OPS historical targets are shifted so inputs end at t−24h.
Missing target observations and configured event-date targets are excluded from OPS history.
